question: By what percentage was the cost per kg of gain in T1 lower than in the control group?
rendered:
According to the document, the cost per kg of gain in the control group was Rs. 210.00, and in the T1 group it was Rs. 169.94.

To find the percentage difference, we can use the formula: 

((Control - T1) / Control) * 100
= ((210 - 169.94) / 210) * 100
= (40.06 / 210) * 100
= 0.191 * 100
= 19.1%

So, the cost per kg of gain in T1 was 19.1% lower than in the control group.
